incidents.name: Spartan Protocol LP share calculation flaw
incidents.notes: The SPARTA/WBNB pool computed the burn payout in removeLiquidity() from its live token balances rather than its recorded baseAmount/tokenAmount reserves, so donating assets to the pool before burning LP units inflated the redemption above the LP's true share.

sources.ref: onchain review: pool 0x3de669c4 created 2020-09-27 by 0x4d523c380b76386c9e41d7f92456cce6c712db87, not by attack sender 0x3b6e7772; no EIP-1967 upgrade events between creation and the incident
